title: Internal: Opening Personal Checking Accounts
summary: This document explains how to open a personal checking account, including eligibility requirements (verified customer, age 18+, no more than 4 personal checking accounts, and no checking accounts closed for cause in the past 6 months) and the step-by-step opening procedure (verify identity, check eligibility, confirm the desired account_class using full official names ending with “Account,” then open via open_bank_account_4821).
